correctness.rationale: For all N>=3, K>0 and real L, the transfer word is reduced exactly to one Nth-degree Chebyshev combination. The central constant for even N is u-u^-1, and the central slope for odd N is Nu-(N-2)/u-2q. Alternating signs at interior Chebyshev nodes plus positive endpoints for L<0 give N-2 real interior roots. The central sign decides whether the last pair lies on the real x axis or exists at purely imaginary +/-i y; the leading term and degree count establish uniqueness/simplicity. The x-to-fugacity map places the imaginary pair on the negative real axis. The exact rational verifier produced 321 checks. The proof is analytic; numerical tests alone are not used as completeness evidence.

value.rationale: The explicit classification of exactly when a natural antiferromagnetic impurity violates the Lee–Yang circle theorem is a structural finite-statistical-mechanics question. The sharp odd/even boundary, unique negative-real reciprocal pair, and triple zero at the odd boundary supply a nontrivial all-N phenomenon beyond a routine parameter substitution, with direct use in complex-field finite-size analysis.
